title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map archives for all of 2023, 2024 and 2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with dated text/image records and explicit gaps.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 retained caption exports. Daily Map 2026: 201 maps, 198 dated days, two undated commentaries, 417 images. Daily Map 2025: 246 maps, 242 dated days, 492 image references. Daily Map 2024: 251 maps, 247 dated days, 502 image references. Daily Map 2023: 248 maps, 245 dated days, 496 image references. All 1,399 calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Method media gaps remain. Annual snapshots preserve missing dates and duplicate date pairs. 2026 includes one historical recovery and two inline image fallbacks; 2024 includes one qualified inline image after a malformed source link; 2025 and 2023 have no request failures. The stated Saturday October 14, 2023 map remains unchanged. No trading validation.
